statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail risk sits in the watch band, below the block threshold, while the environment remains high-stress.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold, so the mapped state stays WATCH. The published danger window covers the quarter-end close from 19:00Z to 20:00Z, where power-hour and market-on-close imbalances overlap.
headline: Cooler core PCE lifts the Nasdaq-100, but narrow leadership and a quarter-end close keep Tail in the watch band
body: August core PCE cooled to 3.0% year over year against about 3.3% expected, with the monthly core at +0.2%. The 10-year Treasury yield eased to roughly 5.22% from its highest level since 2007 and the 2-year sits near 4.83-4.89%. The Nasdaq-100 trades at 30568.15, up 0.75%, having continued up from the 30421.68 open to a 30617.74 session high before retracing about 50 points; the session low of 30415.16 was set early. VIX is 15.72, down 2.0%. Cross-asset confirmation is incomplete: the PHLX Semiconductor Index is at 12612.12, down 0.13%, and WTI is up 2.0% at $91.17 with Brent near $102.56, which cuts against the disinflation read. The Strait of Hormuz disruption and US-Iran conflict remain unresolved and keep energy bid, while a House-passed stopgap extends federal funding to December 11 and removes the October 1 shutdown question. Because the advance is orderly, retracements are appearing and semiconductors are not confirming, the observed price path does not establish the persistent mean-reversion failure that Tail measures; sticky 3.0% core inflation, multiyear-high yields and elevated energy keep Stress high instead. This is the final session of Q3, so quarter-end rebalancing concentrates two-way imbalance risk into the 20:00Z cash close.

lookbackSummary: Published Claude assessments over the preceding 24 hours held Tail between 15 and 20 with a green EA_ON mapping through the Asian and European sessions, then moved to the watch band at 12:35Z and 13:35Z as the US pre-open and the August PCE release approached. Stress eased from the low 70s to the mid 60s overnight before firming again into the US session. One slot, the 14:00Z hour on September 29, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: Tail is expected to stay in the watch band through the US morning, ease into the midday lull, then widen to 23 for the 19:00Z-20:00Z power hour where quarter-end market-on-close imbalances overlap the cash close. Tail then returns to the low band across the post-close and Asian hours, with the low point in the quietest overnight stretch, before firming again into the European session and the 12:30Z US jobless claims release on October 1. No forecast hour reaches the 25 block threshold; ISM Manufacturing at 14:00Z on October 1 falls just beyond this window.
